# Lark Doc Manager

Honest caveats: the underlying skill documentation is written in Chinese; you need a Feishu/Lark account with API access and the lark-cli binary installed; it pairs with the lark-shared skill for authentication; drive-level file operations (upload, permissions, comments) belong to lark-drive, and table data inside docs belongs to lark-sheets/lark-base. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
